This is a feature request, so it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue can be considered, as the feature template describes. Please open a discussion for the generic speed column.

Rich already has some of this. `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows speed in iterations per second when the task total is unknown, and `TransferSpeedColumn` shows byte transfer speed. Custom columns can be written by subclassing `ProgressColumn`; see the [progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst).
